ex.en: I write a diary entry every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上写一则日记。

ex.en: Do you agree with the ideas in the text?
ex.zh: 你同意文中的观点吗？

ex.en: And now I totally agree that it should be taught at school.
ex.zh: 现在我完全同意学校应该教这个。

ex.en: Do you agree with Sam that food tastes better when you work for it?
ex.zh: 你同意萨姆说的，自己劳动得来的食物更好吃吗？

ex.en: Once upon a time, in a quiet small town, there lived a boy named Frank.
ex.zh: 从前，在一个安静的小镇上，住着一个叫弗兰克的男孩。

ex.en: Be careful! The dog may bite you.

ex.zh: “这是最好吃的零食！”他拿起一块，咬了一口。

ex.zh: 他咬破了网，放走了狮子！

ex.zh: 老鼠咬断了绳子。

ex.zh: 后来，一个猎人用网抓住了狮子。

ex.en: Pieces of fishing net may also trap birds, and it's impossible for them to get out by themselves.
ex.zh: 渔网碎片也可能困住鸟儿，它们自己根本出不来。

ex.zh: 猎人抓住了狮子。

ex.zh: 猎人能顺着藤爬上来，杀死我们。

ex.zh: “很久以前，我许下过一个承诺。

ex.en: She promised to put a special lock on my door.
ex.zh: 她答应在我的门上装一把特别的锁。

ex.en: "A long time ago, I made a promise.
ex.zh: “很久以前，我许下过一个承诺。

ex.en: Long ago, people lived happily under the rule of a king.
ex.zh: 很久以前，人们在一位国王的统治下幸福地生活着。

ex.en: Many people lost their homes in the war.
ex.zh: 许多人在战争中失去了家园。

ex.en: Many years ago, China was in the middle of a great war.
ex.zh: 许多年前，中国正处在一场伟大的战争之中。

ex.en: His neighbours said, "How unlucky!" But the farmer just said, "Maybe." Later, his horse came back with seven other horses.
ex.zh: 他的邻居们说：“真倒霉！”但农夫只是说：“也许吧。”后来，他的马带着另外七匹马回来了。

ex.en: Last week, I found myself in a difficult situation with my new neighbour.
ex.zh: 上周，我和新邻居之间遇到了一件难办的事。

ex.en: My grandpa is a wise old man.
ex.zh: 我爷爷是一位睿智的老人。

ex.en: He was not only a great thinker but also a wise teacher.
ex.zh: 他不仅是一位伟大的思想家，还是一位睿智的老师。
